notes: Sheet has two panels. MAIN: Dane (66 ft) down the left edge (its west face is off the sheet; centres taken about 33 ft from the east block line), Ellis, Chase Av., Lingo (NOT OPEN) and Knowlton running east to Linden (40 ft). Linden is one nearly straight line from the top of the sheet (x about 4300) to Knowlton (x about 6456); between Ellis and the railroad its west side is a curved railroad-spur boundary and the C.H.&D. tracks cross it at about y 3000-3600; a single track runs inside Linden north of Ellis. The heavy black line running along Linden's east side and then east at y about 4060 is the city limit / panel edge. INSET (upper right, beyond the heavy line, intersections marked part inset): Dane north of the main panel, with Pullan Av. (T from the west, no width printed, about 43 ft drawn) and Apjones (60 ft); lots 4234-4238 south of Apjones continue the main panel's 4230-4226. Ellis widths: 50 ft from Dane to the creek, 40 ft from the creek to lot 1208 (x about 3880; south face steps north at the creek), 30 ft from there to Linden (north face steps south at x 3880). A small creek (CREEK) crosses the main panel north to south; ignored. The C.H.&D. railroad is ignored.
